name: Badge
description: Small pill label for status, category or count. Optional pulsing status dot.

classes.ayy-badge__dot: Leading status dot (first child). Pulses. Colour follows the variant, or set --ayy-dot.

default.looks: A 2xs pill: wash fill, line-strong border, text colour. muted: hairline and muted text; outline: no fill. success, warning, destructive, info and ai: 10% tint, 30% border and text in their colour. A __dot pulses unless --static.

hover.none: A badge is a label, not a control. For a removable filter use a Chip.

pressed.none: A badge is a label, not a control. For a removable filter use a Chip.

disabled.none: A badge is a label, not a control. For a removable filter use a Chip.

selected.none: A badge is a label, not a control. For a removable filter use a Chip.

error.looks: Red text on a 10% red tint: a failed run, an overdue invoice. Pair the colour with a word.

loading.none: No loading look; a pulsing __dot shows a live state, not progress.

a11y: Colour is never the only signal — the label text must say the status.
The dot is aria-hidden; it's decorative.
do: Use a badge for the status of an item (Synced, Error, Beta), a category or tag next to a title, or a live indicator (dot).
Keep labels to one or two words.
Use the status variants for status, accent spotlights for categories.
dont: Don't make a badge clickable — use Button (ghost/outline, sm).
Don't put long text in a badge — badges never wrap.
Don't stack more than three badges in a row.
